scope: First original 3m OHLC wick reach of C21-selected research swing versus first confirmed original 3m BOS close; never infer true tick order, market/limit fills, author BOS swing, stop or target. All observations use source as-of.

source_restrictions.close_then_limit: C21 strict 3m close is observed; original instructor limit level, retracement, expiry and fill all unknown
source_restrictions.market: No tick feed, bid/ask, author selected pivot or risk target; first source candle high/low is not executable time nor price
source_restrictions.same_bar_stop_and_entry: OHLC cannot determine which was first; never resolve in favor of a trade
